checks.name: required_assets
checks.requirement: all masters, data, QA, and contract assets exist

checks.name: png_600_dpi
checks.requirement: PNG metadata is 600 dpi

checks.name: png_dimensions
checks.requirement: PNG pixels agree with 177.8 x 124.0 mm at 600 dpi within renderer rounding

checks.name: pdf_one_page
checks.requirement: PDF has one page

checks.name: pdf_dimensions
checks.requirement: PDF is 177.8 x 124.0 mm within Matplotlib point rounding

checks.name: svg_vector_text
checks.requirement: SVG remains vector and keeps editable text

checks.name: qa_surface_dimensions
checks.requirement: all QA surfaces match final print size at 180 dpi

checks.name: grayscale_contrast
checks.requirement: grayscale surface retains substantial tonal contrast

checks.name: panel_a_equation
checks.requirement: panel A samples equation (0.9) exactly to binary64 precision

checks.name: panel_b_equation
checks.requirement: panel B recomputes equations (0.4), (0.7), and (0.8)

checks.name: galerkin_linear_rows
checks.requirement: finite projected G and cubic tail slopes are near one

checks.name: galerkin_bounded_mixed_row
checks.requirement: finite projected mixed-row tail slope is near zero

checks.name: galerkin_many_roots
checks.requirement: projected root counts grow monotonically and reach at least 200

checks.name: finite_not_pde
checks.requirement: finite solve is explicitly a projected-ODE diagnostic

checks.name: exact_leakage_ratio
checks.requirement: outside-to-inside norm ratio equals 1/sqrt(2)

checks.name: omitted_shell_support
checks.requirement: the first omitted shell is plus-or-minus 2R

checks.name: source_lineage
checks.requirement: all report and contract sources retain their build hashes

checks.name: output_lineage
checks.requirement: all masters and plotted data retain their build hashes

checks.name: public_byte_identity
checks.requirement: public PDF, SVG, and PNG are byte-identical to masters

checks.name: claim_boundary
checks.requirement: caption and contract separate finite diagnostics from analytic and general-PDE claims

checks.name: visual_inspection_declared
checks.requirement: final-size, grayscale, and PDF-raster surfaces were explicitly inspected
